initial_sample: Sort the 100 retained question IDs, sample 10 without replacement using Python random.Random(10003), inspect all four alpha rows for those questions.
structural_scope: All 400 rows, frozen context identity, four alpha positions, response provenance, nonempty changed tagged pollution and no train/test overlap.
semantic_checks: The supplied clean local step is mathematically sound in context.
The polluted window contains an identifiable mathematical error.
The edit is locally coherent and follows the short-window edit constraints.
The text contains no explicit final-answer giveaway or experiment/meta instruction.
defects: Record individual findings. If a systematic defect appears, inspect all 400 rows before deciding whether the corpus is usable. Preserve every response. No resampling or exclusion based on initial or trained-agent accuracy, and no silent hand edits.
interpretation: A sample audit does not certify every unreviewed corruption. Any corpus construction correction must be documented and frozen before either trained endpoint is evaluated.
